test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The marked price of an article is 150 percent of the cost price. If 30 percent discount is given, then what will be the profit percentage?
solution:
Given

Marked price is 150% of the cost price

Discount = 30%

Concept:

Profit percentage is calculated as (Selling price - Cost price)/Cost price × 100%

Solution:

Selling price after discount = 150% - 30% of 150%

= 150% - 45% = 105%

Profit percentage = (Selling price - Cost price)/Cost price × 100%

= (105% - 100%)/100% × 100% = 5%

Therefore, the profit percentage is 5%.

150/100 = (100 + p)/70 

⇒ 3/2 = (100 + p)/70 

⇒ 105 = 100 + p 

⇒ p = 5%
